title: A Minimal Indirect-Prompt-Injection Sandbox and Defense Leaderboard

original_idea.body: Minimal indirect-prompt-injection sandbox with mock tools and a defense leaderboard.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: prompt injection is a confirmed real-world threat; open sandbox + defense comparison directly serves agent safety.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Guided: minimal harness with mock tools and cheap defenses; clear methodology for novice+mentor.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (sandbox + 2-3 defense leaderboard); building the harness is contained.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly firewall/monitoring infrastructure, public models, weak lab incentive.

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only with one open LLM and mock tools; minimal compute.

novelty.reasoning: Injection benchmarks exist but a minimal reusable sandbox+defense leaderboard may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Benchmarks exist but the minimal reproducible sandbox angle may be open.
